transcript: Exciting bit of theatre news this morning. Ben Platt is making his London theatre debut this summer. The show is called midnight at the Never Get and it is presented as a cabaret act telling the love story between a nightclub singer, played by Ben Platt, and his pianist. Some of you may remember the show actually had an off Broadway premiere in 2018, not starring Platt. It was pretty well reviewed, but unfortunately didn't really go anywhere. So I think this is a really smart next step for a couple of reasons. Number one, it's playing the many Air Chocolate Factory, which is one of my favorite London theaters. It's very small and intimate and more importantly, adaptable. If they wanted to turn the theater into a nightclub, ala just in time, they could easily do that. The second is they now have a star like Ben Platt attached. And if you are an original musical with the aim to go to the West End or Broadway, you kind of need that at least to get people in, see the show and be like, oh, this is actually really good. Then you can cast with up and coming talent. And the third is that it's now being directed by David Cromer, who is, in my opinion, one of the best directors working today. He has a way of emotionally grounding his work that I think is a really great fit for a show like this. So if this show is Not on your radar yet. This is one to keep an eye on.
